LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_GeneratedAgeRange: Age limits for ordinary event pawns (0-100 years, default 0-50). Required developmental stages take precedence when the range cannot accommodate them. Ratkin young, fixed-age pawns and fixed roles such as mothers keep their original ages. Without Toddlers, event infants bypass age-only immobility, not injury or consciousness restrictions.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_ReliefFoodScoreBo: Increase relief-area food scores by this percentage (0-100%, default 10%). Negative scores improve toward zero. This is a score bonus, not a selection probability; distance and food suitability still matter.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_AllowEventPawnsEa: Allow event pawns to eat outside the relief area

Off by default. When disabled, event-generated Ratkin eat only in the relief area and wait or leave if no relief food is available. When enabled, they still search the relief area first, then other colony food, preferring the lowest-value enabled food. Disable foods or change weights on the Food weights page.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_EventFoodWeights_: Lists currently loaded edible items. All foods default to enabled at 10% weight, not scaled by market value. Disabled foods are not sought by event Ratkin. Higher weight is preferred; outside the relief area they still prefer lower-value food. Foods added by other mods default to enabled.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_EventFood_NotLoad: Food defs are not loaded yet.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_EventFood_Weight_: Default 10%. This is a player-set priority, not an automatic ranking by food value. A 0% weight remains edible but ranks after other enabled foods.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_MaxEventPawns_Too: Baseline maximum pawns generated per event (1-100, default 30), including adults, children, Ratkin young and animals. Each event retains its minimum required population; a limit below that minimum is ignored. Fixed groups such as mothers with children are exempt.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_FedWanderDays_Too: Each Ratkin independently stays for a random 50%-150% of this duration after first eating their fill, then leaves the map. Zero means immediate departure; default 0 days. Requires leaving after eating to be enabled. Shelter, employment and story obligations retain their own deadlines.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_WaitWhenNoFood: Wait when no food is available
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_WaitWhenNoFood_To: Wait and periodically search when no reachable food is available, leaving after the waiting period. When disabled, leave immediately. Always search the relief area first. Other colony food is used only when eating outside the relief area is enabled and no relief food is available.
